findings.description: The bucket is explicitly commented as public with no acl set to private and no public access block, allowing unauthenticated access to potentially sensitive customer data stored in it.
No server_side_encryption_configuration block is defined, so objects stored in this bucket are not encrypted at rest.
A customer master data file (customer-master.xlsx) is uploaded to the publicly accessible, unencrypted aws_s3_bucket.data bucket, exposing sensitive customer information.
The bucket stores financial data but has no server_side_encryption_configuration block, leaving data unencrypted at rest.
No server_side_encryption_configuration block is defined for this bucket, so stored objects are not encrypted at rest.
